scenarios.prompt: Instrument a first-session funnel and define the event schema, denominator/window, sampling and build provenance needed for a reviewable report.

criteria.schema: Every event family has versioned typed fields and build/environment provenance.
criteria.metric: Every rate names numerator, denominator, eligibility population and time window.
criteria.privacy: Sampling, consent/privacy/retention and retry/duplicate behavior are explicit.
